name: [WEEKLY] Package manager lifecycle hook spawns runtime with outbound egress to non-registry host within 5 minutes
description:
Detects the joint TTP that every May 2026 supply-chain campaign shares: a package manager (npm/yarn/pnpm, pip, cargo, nuget/dotnet, composer, gem) invokes a preinstall/postinstall lifecycle script that spawns a script-host or downloader child (node, python, sh/bash, powershell, bun, curl/wget, certutil/bitsadmin), and that child — or an immediate sibling — initiates an outbound connection to a host that is NOT a known package registry or VCS within ~5 minutes. This fortnight that chain is the engine of Mini Shai-Hulud's @antv burst, the node-ipc beaconing to sh.azurestaticprovider.net, the durabletask PyPI dropper calling git-service.com, TrapDoor's cross-ecosystem (npm/PyPI/Crates) credential theft, vpmdhaj typosquats exfiltrating to aab.sportsontheweb.net, and Microsoft's dependency-confusion recon to moika.tech / cloudplatform-single-spa.io / t-in-one.io (per Snyk 2026-05-18, StepSecurity 2026-05-19, Aikido 2026-05-19, Microsoft 2026-05-20, Unit 42 2026-05-21, THN 2026-05-23/25/27/29, Microsoft 2026-05-29/30). Kill-chain coverage spans delivery (compromised package pulled), install (lifecycle hook fires), and the first C2/exfil hop — the early-warning window before credential dumping happens. FIRES on developer / CI hosts when an `npm install`-class command produces a script-host child that immediately egresses to a non-registry public host. DOES NOT fire on plain `npm install` traffic to npmjs/yarnpkg/pypi/crates/nuget/rubygems/packagist registries or to github/gitlab/bitbucket VCS, nor on script-host child processes that produce no outbound public connection within the window.

Rationale: Every article in this fortnight's set describes the same execution shape — a tainted package on npm/PyPI/NuGet/Crates/Packagist whose preinstall/postinstall hook spawns a script-host or downloader that immediately phones home (Mini Shai-Hulud → t.m-kosche.com, node-ipc → sh.azurestaticprovider.net, durabletask → git-service.com, TrapDoor → ddjidd564.github.io, vpmdhaj → aab.sportsontheweb.net, dependency-confusion → moika.tech / cloudplatform-single-spa.io / t-in-one.io). Detecting the parent-child-egress triple within a 5-minute window catches the technique regardless of which registry, which package name, or which C2 host this week — and registry/VCS allow-listing prevents the obvious benign baseline (npm install pulling tarballs from registry.npmjs.org or codeload.github.com) from drowning the signal.

note:
**Auto-generated from usecaseintel — analyst port-over required.** Original Splunk SPL / Defender KQL bodies preserved in the `reference` URL. Translate the source query to Elastic's ECS / EQL syntax before enabling.

### Source query (Defender KQL)
```
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let CorrelationWindowSec = 300;
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","npm","yarn.exe","yarn","pnpm.exe","pnpm","pip.exe","pip","pip3","pip3.exe","cargo.exe","cargo","nuget.exe","nuget","dotnet.exe","dotnet","composer","composer.phar","gem","bundle","node.exe","node"]);
let PkgMgrCmdHints = dynamic(["npm install","npm i ","npm ci","yarn install","yarn add","pnpm install","pnpm add","pip install","pip3 install","cargo install","nuget install","dotnet add package","dotnet restore","composer install","composer require","gem install","bundle install"]);
let HookRuntimes = dynamic(["node.exe","node","python.exe","python","python3","python3.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","sh","bash","dash","bun.exe","bun","curl.exe","curl","wget.exe","wget","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let RegistryAllow = dynamic(["registry.npmjs.org","registry.yarnpkg.com","pypi.org","files.pythonhosted.org","crates.io","static.crates.io","api.nuget.org","nuget.org","www.nuget.org","rubygems.org","packagist.org","repo.packagist.org","github.com","raw.githubusercontent.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","codeload.github.com","gitlab.com","bitbucket.org"]);
let HookSpawns =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (PkgMgrParents))
         or (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where FileName in~ (HookRuntimes)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
    | project ProcTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              ChildProc   = FileName,
              ChildPid    = ProcessId;
let Egress =
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType in~ ("ConnectionSuccess","ConnectionAttempted","ConnectionFound","DnsConnectionInspected")
    | extend Host = tolower(coalesce(RemoteUrl, ""))
    | where Host == "" or not(RegistryAllow has_any (split(Host, ".")))
    | where not(Host has_any (RegistryAllow))
    | project NetTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RemoteIP, RemoteUrl, RemotePort,
              NetInitProc = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              NetInitCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              NetInitPid  = InitiatingProcessId;
HookSpawns
| join kind=inner Egress on DeviceId
| where NetTime between (ProcTime .. ProcTime + CorrelationWindowSec * 1s)
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', NetTime, ProcTime)
| where DelaySec >= 0 and DelaySec <= CorrelationWindowSec
| where (NetInitProc =~ ChildProc) or (NetInitPid == ChildPid) or (NetInitProc in~ (HookRuntimes))
| summarize FirstSeen = min(ProcTime), LastEgress = max(NetTime),
            EgressCount = count(),
            DistinctDests = dcount(coalesce(RemoteUrl, tostring(RemoteIP))),
            Destinations = make_set(coalesce(RemoteUrl, tostring(RemoteIP)), 25),
            Ports = make_set(RemotePort, 10),
            SampleParentCmd = any(ParentCmd),
            SampleChildCmd  = any(ChildCmd),
            MinDelaySec = min(DelaySec)
          by DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage, ChildImage, ChildProc
| where DistinctDests >= 1
| order by FirstSeen desc
```
